gloss: to mourn; to hold a memorial service; to pay one's respects to the dead

definitions.gloss: to mourn; to hold a memorial service; to console the spirit of the deceased
definitions.explanation: To express grief for the dead and perform rituals or acts to honor their memory. Encompasses both the emotional aspect of mourning and the religious/ceremonial aspect of memorial services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弔|とむら}う。
⟦{戦没者|せんぼつしゃ}→戦没者：23238_senbotsusha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弔|とむら}う⟦{式典|しきてん}→式典：09526_shikiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A ceremony was held to honor the spirits of the war dead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手向|たむ}けて⟦{故人|こじん}→故人：02807_kojin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弔|とむら}い、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{祈|いの}り→祈り：13732_inori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捧|ささ}げた→捧げる：02055_sasageru⟧。
examples.english: We offered flowers to mourn the deceased and quietly offered our prayers.

notes:
A godan verb (u-row conjugation: {弔|とむら}わない, {弔|とむら}って). The word carries a solemn, respectful tone and is used in formal and literary contexts about death and memorial. In everyday speech, ⟦{冥福|めいふく}→冥福：16396_meifuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧ (to pray for someone's rest in peace) is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{死者|ししゃ}→死者：13225_shisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弔|とむら}う: to mourn the dead
- ⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{弔|とむら}う: to console a spirit
- {弔|とむら}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧: words of condolence
- {弔|とむら}い{合戦|がっせん}: a battle fought to avenge the dead
